sentences.text:
16.05.2024 Order No. (Through hybrid mode)
02.
1.

This is the second application of the petitioner under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with Nimakhandi P.S. Case No. 265 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 192 of 2023 pending in the Court of the learned Addl. Sessions Judge -cum- Special Judge under POCSO Act, Berhampur for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 420, 417 of IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act.

2. BLAPL No. 394 of 2024 filed earlier application by the petitioner had been dismissed by me on 19.02.2024 and granting liberty to the petitioner to move for bail afresh after completion of further investigation or if there is delay in completion of investigation.

3. Mr. Suryakanta Dwibedi, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the preliminary charge sheet has been submitted on 19.10.2023 and thereafter, after completion of further investigation,
final charge sheet has been submitted on 04.04.2024.
4. Issue notice to the informant and the victim who has become a major in the meanwhile.
Requisites for issuance of notice to the informant and the victim through Registered Post/Speed Post with A.D shall be filed by 20.05.2024.
The notice shall be made returnable within three weeks.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner shall also serve an extra copy of the brief on Mr. Tripathy,
learned Addl.

Standing Counsel by 20.05.2024, for service of notice on informant and the victim through the concerned I.O./I.I.C, who shall also inform the informant and the victim about the date Prasant Kumar Nayak vs State Of Odisha
